field_evidence: Official register proposal explicitly identifies demolition of the existing garage and erection of one double garage with home office above. Site Location Plan/Block Plan 25001-P01-B, proposed garage elevations/floor plans 25001-P04-A, and proposed elevations/floor plans 25001-P03-E support the same single planned structure; the Decision Notice condition 7 expressly calls it the garage/office building. Existing-dwelling extensions and the demolished existing garage are not counted as additional distinct structures.
